decisions: Certification passed time replaces chapter publication date.
No ISSUE, ISSUED or SERIAL caption in artwork.
Four-digit year; milliseconds, not invented finer precision.
A future formal award should freeze its first passed event time; retries and art rerenders must not reset it.

standard.name: RFC 3339 section 5.6
standard.canonical: UTC timestamp with exactly three fractional digits
standard.display: Asia/Shanghai local time with numeric offset; typography is a display composition, not an RFC wire string
standard.precision: millisecond representation, not a claim of calibrated millisecond clock accuracy
